title: Ensure pushing or merging of new code is restricted to trusted users
description: Every approval rule on pull requests is worth nothing if the same people can push straight to the branch instead. Azure Repos declares no such restriction: a branch with any Required branch policy accepts changes only through pull requests, except from holders of "Bypass policies when pushing" — so whether a required policy applies, and who holds that bypass, decide this control together.
remediation: Configure at least one Required branch policy on the default branch — Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> <default branch> — which makes Azure Repos accept changes only through pull requests; to cover every repository, add one at Project settings -> Repositories -> All Repositories -> Policies -> Branch Policies -> + -> "Protect the default branch of each repository". Then review who holds "Bypass policies when pushing" at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Security and at the branch's Branch security: each holder can push past every policy. Name the service identities that genuinely need it in allowedBypassPrincipals; thresholds.maxBypassPrincipals sets how many others may hold it (-1 turns the check off).
fixSummary: Add a required policy, revoke push bypass at Project settings -> Repositories -> <repo>.
